name: When I Work
summary: When I Work lists Essentials at $2.50, Pro at $5 and Premium at $8 per user a month, with a 14-day trial and no free plan. Shift swaps and OpenShifts are on Essentials, scheduling rules start on Pro and single sign-on is on Premium. Time tracking is a separate add-on with no price on the page.

facts.text: The pricing FAQ says $2.50 per user applies to single-location teams and $5 to multi-location businesses, which does not match the plan table where Essentials includes multi-location scheduling.
Time Tracking and Attendance is an add-on toggle on the pricing page with no price shown.
The security page names no SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA claim, relies on AWS hosting and lists mobile two-step verification.
During a paid term the number of users cannot be reduced, and cancellation or early termination is non-refundable.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Page does not say whether this is a monthly or annual rate. Adds auto scheduling, OpenShifts and shift swaps

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Adds scheduling rules, role permissions and custom reporting

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Adds API access, webhooks and SAML single sign-on

hiddenCosts: Time Tracking and Attendance is sold as an add-on with no price on the pricing page.
Seats cannot be reduced until the current monthly or annual term ends.

contract.cancellation: Cancel in the web app under Account and Billing; email or phone requests do not count. Cancellation is non-refundable.
contract.dataExport: Access to customer data ends on cancellation, so schedules and timesheets should be exported first; the company deletes or obfuscates data within a reasonable time.
